description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.117 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. US Congressional stock trades (STOCK Act disclosures). Two modes: supply a ticker to get all congress member trades in that stock (with excess-return-vs-SPY performance), or omit ticker for recent market-wide congressional activity. Returns representative, party, chamber, transaction type, dollar range, dates, and historical performance vs. SPY. Sourced from Quiver Quant's STOCK Act aggregator — no API key required. $0.117/call.
